modes.error: {"mode":"error","status":429} -> status + default openai error body {"error":{"message":"mock rate limit","type":"rate_limit_exceeded","code":"rate_limit_exceeded"}}
modes.script: NEW MODE REQUESTED: {"mode":"script","non_stream":<json object>} serves the given JSON as the non-stream reply (200); {"mode":"script","stream_events":[[null,<chunk obj|string>],...]} serves the list as SSE frames (each [null, "[DONE]"] emits 'data: [DONE]'); needed by cases 11-14

state_and_ordering: Run cases in run_order. Cases 1-18 are stateless against the credential.
Run S2d4-error-429 (19) then S2d4-cooldown-second (20) BACK-TO-BACK in the same shell (< 0.5s apart) — the rate-limit cooldown window is ~1s.
After case 20, pause > 1.2s before S2d4-stream-error-429 (21) so the cooldown has expired and the request reaches the mock.
Run S2d4-stream-disconnect (22) last; delete the control file afterwards (mode back to happy).
Cases 17, 18 and the count_tokens case 10 must show an EMPTY upstream wire log slice (no request reached the mock).
Slicing the shared mock wire log per case is the oracle's normal procedure (ts fields identify boundaries).

comparison_rules.downstream: byte-exact after masking whitelisted dynamic fields (Date, X-CPA-TRACE-ID, ports, ts).
comparison_rules.upstream_jsonl: deep-equal JSON per line (arrays order-sensitive; object key order informative only) — the reference's emission order is documented in the section but not contract-pinned; assert headers semantically (presence/absence).
comparison_rules.deterministic_values: message_start usage.input_tokens and count_tokens input_tokens are DETERMINISTIC (o200k_base over fixed segments) — do NOT mask them; the recorded reference values are the goldens even if my precomputed numbers differ.

cases.purpose: Baseline non-stream round trip. Pins: x-api-key auth accepted on the Claude route; alias->upstream model rewrite (mock-model -> mock-gpt-model); system STRING -> one system message whose content is an ARRAY of text parts; user string content preserved as string; max_tokens passthrough; explicit stream:false in the upstream body; canned chat.completion -> Claude message JSON with exact key order id/type/role/model/content/stop_reason/stop_sequence/usage and usage input 9 / output 6; upstream headers UA cli-proxy-openai-compat + Content-Type + Bearer, NO Accept, no client header forwarding; response model keeps the UPSTREAM name (no force-mapping).

Sampling/stop/user params: system as 2-block array -> single system message with 2 text parts; temperature forwarded; top_k DROPPED; stop_sequences -> stop array; top-level user forwarded; metadata.user_id DROPPED; user content array -> content array of text parts.
Claude Code attribution block dropped from system (text left-trimmed starting with 'x-anthropic-billing-header:'); temperature wins over top_p (top_p DROPPED when both present).

mock.note: canned SSE = 3 data frames then clean chunked terminator, NO [DONE]

cases.purpose: thinking.type=enabled + budget_tokens=8192 -> upstream reasoning_effort 'medium' (budget->level mapping); assistant thinking block WITHOUT a signature is DROPPED upstream (default config, is-compat off); assistant text part survives as content array.

tools -> upstream functions array {type:function,function:{name,description,parameters}}; input_schema is RE-SERIALIZED (sorted map keys) and normalized: type=object without properties GAINS properties:{}; missing input_schema -> parameters {"type":"object","properties":{}}; tool_choice {type:any} -> "required".

Full tool loop upstream shape: assistant tool_use -> assistant message with content:"" and tool_calls (arguments = RAW input bytes as a JSON string); tool_result blocks REORDERED to match the preceding tool_use id order (02,01 -> 01,02) and emitted as separate role:tool messages BEFORE any user content; mid-conversation system message becomes a user message wrapped in <system-reminder> tags, emitted AFTER the tool messages; remaining user text becomes the final user message.

request.body: {"model":"mock-model","max_tokens":300,"tools":[{"name":"Get_Weather","description":"Get current weather","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}},"required":["city"]}}],"messages":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"What's the weather in Paris and London?"}]},{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01ABC","name":"Get_Weather","input":{"city":"Paris"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_02XYZ","name":"Get_Weather","input":{"city":"London"}}]},{"role":"system","content":"Use metric units."},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_02XYZ","content":"12C rain"},{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_01ABC","content":"18C sunny"},{"type":"text","text":"Summarize."}]}]}

expected.upstream_body: {"model":"mock-gpt-model","messages":[{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"What's the weather in Paris and London?"}]},{"role":"assistant","content":"","tool_calls":[{"id":"toolu_01ABC","type":"function","function":{"name":"Get_Weather","arguments":"{\"city\":\"Paris\"}"}},{"id":"toolu_02XYZ","type":"function","function":{"name":"Get_Weather","arguments":"{\"city\":\"London\"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"toolu_01ABC","content":"18C sunny"},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"toolu_02XYZ","content":"12C rain"},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"<system-reminder>\nUse metric units.\n</system-reminder>"}]},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Summarize."}]}],"max_tokens":300,"stream":false,"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"Get_Weather","description":"Get current weather","parameters":{"properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}},"required":["city"],"type":"object"}}}]}

cases.purpose: Image content: base64 source -> image_url part with 'data:image/png;base64,<data>'; url source -> image_url passthrough; part order preserved.

tool_result carrying only an image: role:tool content becomes the placeholder '[Tool returned image content; the images follow in the next user message.]' and the image is relayed as a FOLLOWING user message whose first content part is the notice 'Images returned by the preceding tool call(s):'; no extra empty user message is emitted.

expected.upstream_body: {"model":"mock-gpt-model","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Show me the diagram."},{"role":"assistant","content":"","tool_calls":[{"id":"toolu_img01","type":"function","function":{"name":"render_diagram","arguments":"{\"name\":\"flow\"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"toolu_img01","content":"[Tool returned image content; the images follow in the next user message.]"},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Images returned by the preceding tool call(s):"},{"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"data:image/png;base64,aWNvbg=="}}]}],"max_tokens":150,"stream":false}

is-compat: true config variant: an assistant thinking block WITHOUT a valid signature is PRESERVED upstream as reasoning_content on the assistant message (content array + reasoning_content), instead of dropped. Requires a SECOND openai-compatibility provider entry (see config_variant).

cases.purpose: Missing API key on /v1/messages: 401 with the MIDDLEWARE shape '{"error":"Missing API key"}' — the plain string-error shape, NOT the Claude type/message error object; CORS block still present. No upstream call.

Unknown model: 400 with the CLAUDE error shape '{"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"unknown provider for model <model>"}}' — the OpenAI-style code/param fields of the internal error are DROPPED on the Claude wire. No upstream call.

Upstream 429 (mock error mode, wire-shaped body {"error":{"message":"mock rate limit","type":"rate_limit_exceeded","code":"rate_limit_exceeded"}}): the STATUS passes through (429) and the body is RESHAPED for Claude clients by extracting error.type + error.message (code dropped). Sets the rate-limit cooldown that case 20 observes.
